newsitem.title: INDIA: India Crompton sees 96/97 net at 800 mln.
newsitem.headline: India Crompton sees 96/97 net at 800 mln.

text.p: Indian electrical equipment maker Crompton Greaves expects a post-tax profit of 800 million rupees for 1996/97 (April-March), its managing director said.
"We had projected a net profit of 80 crores (800 million rupees)," K.K. Nohria, managing director, told reporters at a news conference on Wednesday.
"We have still not modified that figure," he said.
The firm's net in 1995/96 was 640 million rupees.
It reported a sharp drop in net profit for the six months ended September 30, 1996, at 160.5 million rupees.
Nohria said second half profits would be sharply higher from increased turnover, but did not elaborate.

Analysts attributed the fall in first half profits to a slowdown in the economy which hit Crompton's sales, mounting receivables and interest costs and delayed receipt of a $50 million issue of global depositary receipts issued in July.
